summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, reporting its unaudited consolidated operating results for April 2026. The filing discloses monthly revenue of approximately NT$20.50 billion, income from operations of NT$4.83 billion, net income attributable to shareholders of NT$3.73 billion, EBITDA of NT$8.24 billion, and EPS of NT$0.48. It also includes routine updates on sales volume, funds lent to others, endorsements/guarantees, and financial derivatives. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or strategic review—is announced. This is a routine periodic earnings release by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard current report and not a special situation.
